task.title: Fix Autofill Issues in Chrome
task.shortdesc: Troubleshoot and resolve issues when Chrome does not suggest your saved autofill information.

context.p: If Chrome is not suggesting your saved info, try the following solutions:

info.p: Make sure that Save and fill is turned on for the info that you want to autofill.
Confirm the name and email shared from your Google Account for autofill at myaccount.google.com/personal-info.
Confirm the information that you want to populate is saved, then select More Passwords and autofill .
If your login credentials fail, such as passkeys or PINs, Chrome cannot access your sensitive info. See Fix issues with passwords and passkeys for more help.

ul.li: If the website is secure, Chrome may not be able to detect certain fields in the form.
If the website is not secure enough, it may not be able to receive info from Chrome.

info.p: To allow autofill to use info from Google Wallet, make sure that Use passes across Google is turned on.
